description: This GitHub resource publishes solar-energy samples and clear-sky indicators for southern and central Mozambique. The dataset author supplies CSV tables and one Excel workbook, with location-labelled daily irradiance and accepted or rejected observation summaries; many filenames identify 2012–2014 coverage. A companion repository supplies four PNG analysis figures and is grouped with this release. Files are publicly accessible, and the Data article states CC BY 4.0, although GitHub declares no separate licence. These regional observations can support PV generation simulations and comparisons of clear, intermediate and cloudy conditions. The article describes a wider 2005–2024 study than the visible file labels, so complete temporal coverage is unverified. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
